company_profile.about_us: Varthaman Agri Seeds has a vision for creating better livelihoods for Indian farmers and all-round success of the farming community delivering high quality and high yielding vegetable and field crop hybrids / improved varieties possessing high levels of abiotic and biotic resistance. Our Organization has it's core strength in vegetable hybrid seeds breeding, production and marketing, supported by professionally qualified and experienced professionals. Varthaman Agri Seeds has accomplishing success in breeding hybrids for different markets and released compatible hybrids suitable for various agro-climatic zones of Indian states. We have developed chilli hybrids in red-dry and fresh green chilli segments with adaptability towards various stress environment which are very popular in the market. Tomato and Okra hybrids have created niche in the market. Gourd's, Melon's, Carrot, Beetroot, Cabbage, Cauliflower, Coriander and hybrid marigold have achieved market popularity in a short span of time due to our dedicated team with more than two decades of experience. With the tremendous support and acceptance of our hybrids by valued farmers, distributors, dealers and all our well wishers Varthaman Agri Seeds has achieved wonderful and trusted growth in a short span of time.
